description: Two radar outlines with no fill, comparing this month and last month by stroke alone.
overview: Two radar outlines without fill, comparing this month with last month by stroke alone. Use it when filled shapes would hide each other, especially with more than two series.
usage: Replace `chartData` and rename the series keys in the data, the `Radar` elements and `chartConfig`. Add more `Radar` elements for extra series; give each a distinct color in the config.
notes: Without fill or legend, color is the only cue for which line is which, so add a legend or pick strongly contrasting colors.
